latest.title: Vitalik Buterin says Hegotá could be Ethereum’s last ‘normal’ fork
latest.description: Ethereum’s Vitalik Buterin said PeerDAS marked the start of Ethereum’s transition “from being just a blockchain to being something much more powerful.”

latest.title: Brent gains 2.7% as Trump rejects Iranian proposal to reopen Hormuz Strait
latest.description: Iran offered to reopen the key shipping route and restart negotiations with the U.S. within seven days, if the Trump administration agreed to Tehran's conditions.

latest.title: SpaceX prepares to send Starship rocket to orbit for first time
latest.description: Elon Musk's SpaceX is poised to launch a historic test flight of its massive Starship rocket early Monday.

latest.title: China posts weakest industrial profit growth this year, expanding 4.2% in August
latest.description: Economists expect Beijing to lean harder on stimulus to stabilize corporate profitability, as consolidation accelerates in sectors facing sluggish demand and fierce competition.

latest.title: Bitcoin, Nasdaq futures decline as Trump won’t rule out more Iran strikes
latest.description: Trump on Sunday didn’t rule out additional strikes on Iran before the midterm elections, even as he said the war could end soon.

latest.title: Northern Star shares pop as Australian gold miner rejects $27 billion takeover proposal
latest.description: Northern Star shares jumped more than 9% after the Australian gold miner rejected a takeover proposal from Gold Fields.

latest.title: Trump-Xi summit analysis: 'Tangible outcomes' needed for U.S.-China truce to hold
latest.description: U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping met in Washington, D.C., last week and signaled plans to meet two more times this year.

latest.title: Newsom signs California ban on public officials issuing memecoins
latest.description: The law also restricts crypto companies from offering certain memecoins tied to public officials to California residents and takes effect for tokens issued from Jan. 1, 2027.

latest.title: Zano rolls blockchain back a month after Gateway Address exploit
latest.description: The Zano blockchain has been restarted at the block height that came immediately before Hard Fork 6, which introduced Gateway Addresses.

latest.title: THORChain under fire over Bitget, ETH evolves beyond blockchain: Hodler’s Digest
latest.description: THORChain refuses to blacklist addresses linked to the Bitget hack. Vitalik Buterin says Ethereum is evolving from being a mere blockchain, into a world cryptographic computer.

latest.title: Taxpayer-funded Trump ads draw bipartisan scrutiny ahead of midterms
latest.description: TV ads featuring Trump are expanding nationally, prompting bipartisan questions over whether they comply with restrictions on taxpayer-funded publicity.

latest.title: Anthropic CEO Amodei set to meet with Trump after missing state dinner
latest.description: As top tech CEOs rubbed elbows at President Trump's glitzy dinner for Chinese President Xi on Thursday, Anthropic's CEO was noticeably absent.

latest.title: Iran's foreign minister says Tehran ready for 'doomsday' war with U.S., but leaves diplomacy on the table
latest.description: Iran's foreign minister says talks are the only way to break the deadlock, while its navy says it's analyzing data from a captured U.S. underwater drone.

latest.title: Nor'easter delays hundreds of flights, airlines waive change fees
latest.description: Flight disruptions were rising in Boston over the weekend.

latest.title: Debt-hungry AI companies face increased risk as bond yields spike
latest.description: The AI infrastructure buildout shows no sign of slowing, but the surge in Treasury yields means it's at least going to cost more.

latest.title: At NFL games this season, drone defense tech aims to bring down disruptions
latest.description: The NFL told CNBC it recorded 10,852 drone violations over stadiums between 2021 and 2025. The Jaguars became the first team to sign a drone defense firm.
